title: A case report for a novel AML translocation t(4;15)(q31;q22)
description: Preliminary characterization of this t(4;15) translocation that confers growth-stimulatory response to retinoid-based therapy. RNA-Seq and Sanger sequencing confirmed the t(9;11) MLL(KMT2A-AF9(MLLT3) at diagnosis and a novel t(4;11) translocation TMEM154-RASGRF1
